subsystem.name: RuntimeResourceAndSessionManagement
subsystem.responsibility: Module-global runtime objects for the F1C engine: dual-resource cleanup and subslot/vibration teardown, multiplayer session mode and session-state transitions, named-resource file loading with a timed loading screen, the main per-frame game tick with delta-time integration, weather-condition report writing, D3D texture-copy/sound-buffer/render-resource helpers (including surface lock/copy, resampling and the D3D PSGP function-table init), renderer vtable dispatch, and small masked-accessor/init thunks.

summary: Derived architecture proposal for 23 validated functions in scope generic_runtime_objects. One packet-DERIVED owner (D3DTextureCopyContext, 0x005063A5) forms a real D3D texture-copy context class holding destination/source surfaces and a surface type, driving a first-success-wins transfer chain and COM-style releases on every exit. The other twenty-two functions have packet-UNKNOWN owners and are grouped conservatively: GUESS classes for the resource-cleanup pair (0x004DCD10/0x004DD000), session objects (0x004E2370 mode config, 0x004EF5A0 session-state manager), the weather writer (0x004FE820), render-resource teardown (0x005064CF/0x00506554), the surface lock-box wrapper (0x00506971), and the renderer vtable dispatcher (0x00519828); GUESS interfaces collect the D3D context factory helpers (0x0050070D/0x005007EF/0x00500B42/0x00506538), resource loader (0x004F9D60), game frame loop (0x004FA7E0), subslot teardown (0x004E0E70), texture resampler (0x00504933), D3D PSGP table initializer (0x0050FEA7) and startup dispatcher (0x0050C27F). Class boundaries are weak: equal base+offset tuples (e.g. field:this:0x00000000) occur on many unrelated objects and are deliberately NOT merged. Vtable method targets for surfaces/render resources are indirect with no static addresses. Session-type enums, state identifiers, flag-bit meanings and a cluster of fact-table globals absent from the decompiled bodies remain unresolved.

function_roles.role: Dual-resource teardown: run secondary-resource destructor/free sequence (this+0x4), then cascade cleanup on primary resource (this+0x0); return the computation-helper result
Two-call passthrough on this: run ResourceCleanup_cd10(this) first, then sub_4DCF80(this) and return its result; invoked by DestructorWithResourceCleanup (0x0045B400)

Per-index subslot teardown: conditional release of two resource regions (stride 296, slot+81/slot+98), vibration reset via VibrationStateMachine(a2, 0.0), conditional FlagFieldBitManipulation(0,0,0,0)
Multiplayer session-mode configuration: normalize the session-type argument onto this+0xB6C and initialize 4 session-slot entries at this+0x1EC (stride 0x128) to -1

Session state-pointer update at this+0x32BC with transition side effects: position recording on exit-to-NULL (session type 5), cleanup-flag clear + AI speed-delta set + field zeroing on entry-to-state-1

Named-resource file loader: direct path then default directory (byte_5EA438) + override (dword_5EC408) fallback, timed loading screen (clipped render + present, optional input polling) for a2 seconds, handle release, returns 1/0

Main per-frame game tick: render display-list configuration from packed flag bits, global-float mode selection, one-shot display init, per-vehicle UI dispatch, session audio dispatch, pause overlay, delta-time accumulation (clamped to 0.5 s), audio-init retry on pending flag
Weather-conditions report writer: open config-path file, header, 8-session loop with transition simulation (10.0-unit steps) and linked-list weather-point dump (nodes at +12), close and return 0/-1

D3D texture-surface lock+copy context init: lock/copy the surface, fill descriptor, init D3D context, unconditionally tear down render resources and dual-vtable objects; fail-fast with -2005530516 on null args
Sound-buffer / D3D-context setup from a parameter block: guard a1/a4/a9, default a10, prepare descriptor via sub_506971, init via D3DContextInit, tear down both helper objects on every exit
Sound-buffer/resource init forwarding the descriptor (4 words) plus arguments to AudioSoundBufferSetup (0x005007EF); guarded on a1/a4, wrapped between sub_506538/ThunkToFUN0050653e

3D texture resampling from source to destination dimensions via fixed-point scaling, two 16-byte staging buffers and vtable scanline fetch/write; type-byte guard and SEH frame; returns 0 or failure code

D3D texture-copy context init: validate surface type, create source/destination surfaces via the FourCC-dispatched factory, run the first-success-wins transfer chain, release both surfaces through vtable slot 0 on every exit
Render-resource teardown: optional vtable+112 copy when this[1..3] valid and flag bit 0 clear, release this[2]/this[3] via vtable+8, clear all slots, return 0
Thiscall single-field zero initializer: write 0 to *this and return this for call-chained construction
IDA jump thunk: forwards this to RenderResourceTeardown and returns its result unchanged
Thunk forwarding this unchanged to a named-but-unaddressed VTableReleaseClear target; returns the delegated result

Lock a 3D surface sub-region and copy surface info into the a2 descriptor: release stored interface, query description/capabilities, block-align the rect by FourCC, LockBox, fill descriptor, store surface at *this
Destructor-style teardown: install vtable off_5ADBB8, color/palette cleanup via VertexColorPackRGBto16, free heap resource at index 1051, release child objects via VtableSetFreeChild
Startup sequencing wrapper: call sub_50FEA7 with literal 1, then dispatch through global function pointer off_5D77C8 and return its result

D3D PSGP function-table init: copy template off_5D78B0 to off_5D77C8, init via FunctionTableInit, apply registry DisableD3DXPSGP override, patch for detected CPU variant (dword_5D7998 1/2/3) or reset to 0xFFFF
Null-guarded masked read: return a3 & *(dword*)(a2+8) when a1/a2 non-null, else 0; invoked by sub_50210E
Render-subsystem vtable dispatch: read renderer interface at this+0x188, indirect call through interface+4 with object, three zeroed leads and caller args; return result unchanged

classes.name: D3DTextureCopyContext
classes.responsibility: Holder of a destination/source D3D surface pair and a surface-type parameter for a texture-copy operation; validates the surface type, creates both surfaces through the FourCC-dispatched surface factory, runs a first-success-wins transfer-method chain, and releases both surfaces through COM vtable slot 0 on every exit path.

classes.name: RenderResourceContainer
classes.responsibility: Container of up to three releaseable render interfaces (this+0x4/0x8/0xC) plus a flags word (this+0x0); teardown optionally runs a vtable+112 copy operation, then releases each interface via its vtable+8 method and clears all slots.

classes.name: D3DSurfaceInterface
classes.responsibility: COM-style D3D surface wrapper: stores a locked surface pointer at this+0x0, releases a previously stored interface, and exposes lock/description/capability vtable methods (slots +28/+32/+36) used to block-align a requested rect by FourCC and lock it.

classes.name: DualResourceHolder
classes.responsibility: Holds a primary resource (this+0x0) and a secondary resource (this+0x4); teardown runs the secondary destructor/free sequence, cascade-cleans the primary resource, and returns a computed result.

classes.name: MultiplayerSessionConfig
classes.responsibility: Stores the multiplayer session mode at this+0xB6C (normalized from a session-type argument, cases 4/5/6 to 1/2/3, cases 1/2/3 to 0, default raw) and initializes a 4-entry session-slot array at this+0x1EC (stride 0x128) to -1.

classes.name: SessionStateManager
classes.responsibility: Session-state holder: session object pointer at this+0x0, current session-state pointer at this+0x32BC, last-recorded position at this+0x34EC/0x34F0/0x34F4; runs transition side effects (position/time recording on exit, cleanup-flag clear and AI speed-delta update on entry).

classes.name: WeatherConditionSimulator
classes.responsibility: Weather-condition runtime: current/start iterator pointers (this+0x38/0x3C) over a linked list of weather data points chained at node+12, a pointed-to value (this+0x44); writes per-session weather reports and steps weather transitions in fixed 10.0-unit intervals.

classes.name: RendererOwner
classes.responsibility: Object holding a renderer interface pointer at this+0x188; dispatches render-subsystem calls through the function pointer at interface+4, passing the object, three zeroed leading arguments and the caller arguments.

state_machines.name: SubslotVibrationState
transitions: Per-subslot clear via VibrationStateMachine(index, 0.0) during SubslotCleanup teardown (0x004E0E70).

state_machines.name: SessionStateMachine
transitions: Exit to NULL while session type dword_7C569C == 5 records the position at this+0x34EC..0x34F4 and race elapsed time via transform helpers and sub_447780.

Entry to state 1 (prior state != 1) queries PositionChangeMonitor, clears session cleanup flags via SessionCleanupFlagClear, sets the AI speed delta via AISpeedDeltaSetter and zeroes session dwords +17236/+17240.

state_machines.name: WeatherTransitionSimulator
transitions: Advance by 10.0-unit steps via AudioADSREnvelope(this, 10.0, v9, 0) until v9 reaches the per-session weather duration from sub_4FB910.

interfaces.name: D3DTextureContextFactory
interfaces.purpose: Builds a descriptor and initializes a D3D texture-copy / sound-buffer context: guards input arguments (fail-fast -2005530516), defaults the size flag to 524292, calls D3DContextInit, and tears down local helper objects on every exit.

interfaces.name: ResourceLoadingService
interfaces.purpose: Opens a named resource via a direct path first, then a default-directory + override path; runs a timed loading screen (clipped render region + present) for a2 seconds with optional input polling; releases the handle and returns 1 on success, 0 on failure.

interfaces.name: GameFrameLoop
interfaces.purpose: Per-frame game loop: render display-list configuration, one-shot display init, per-vehicle UI update, session audio dispatch, pause-overlay rendering, delta-time integration (clamped to 0.5 s) and a pending audio-init retry chain.

interfaces.name: SubsystemTeardownService
interfaces.purpose: Tears down per-index subsystem subslots: conditionally releases two resource regions (stride 296) and clears per-subslot vibration state; used by SubsystemStateMachine and RepairServiceStateDispatcher.

interfaces.name: TextureResampler
interfaces.purpose: Resamples a 3D texture between source and destination objects using fixed-point coordinate scaling, two staging buffers and vtable scanline fetch/write methods; SEH-guarded.

interfaces.name: D3DPSGPFunctionTableInitializer
interfaces.purpose: Builds and patches a module-global D3D PSGP function-pointer table (off_5D77C8) from a template (off_5D78B0), honoring a registry DisableD3DXPSGP override and selecting a CPU-feature variant; records state in dword_5D7998.

interfaces.name: StartupDispatcher
interfaces.purpose: Sequences startup by invoking the D3D PSGP table initializer with a literal argument, then dispatching through a global function pointer and returning its result.

compatibility_contracts.name: SessionStatePointerAndTransitionContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A session manager must store the active session-state pointer at this+0x32BC; exiting to NULL while session type dword_7C569C == 5 must record the position at this+0x34EC..0x34F4 and race elapsed time via transform helpers and sub_447780; entering state 1 must query the position-change monitor, clear session cleanup flags, set the AI speed delta and zero session dwords +17236/+17240.

compatibility_contracts.name: ResourceFileLoadContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A named resource must first be attempted via a direct path; on failure it is retried with the default directory (byte_5EA438) + override (dword_5EC408) formatted as "%s%s"; a timed loading screen runs for a2 seconds (input polling breaks early when dword_7CB218 > 0); returns 1 on success and 0 on failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: FrameTickTimeIntegrationContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Each frame the raw delta time (sub_556730) is accumulated; when dbl_5D6D70 == 1.0 the session clock (dbl_8AFEA0) advances by the delta and the delta is clamped to 0.5 s; when byte_8AFE72 was set, the audio-init retry chain (RepeatedCallLoop_f040 on dword_8ACEA0) and the scene-setup render run.

compatibility_contracts.name: D3DTextureCopyContextLifecycleContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A D3D texture-copy context holds a destination surface (this+0x0), a source surface (this+0x4) and a surface type (this+0x8); both surfaces are created through the FourCC-dispatched surface factory and must be released through COM vtable slot 0 on every exit path; the transfer chain is first-success-wins.

compatibility_contracts.name: WeatherReportWriterContract
compatibility_contracts.description: A weather-conditions writer must produce a report over exactly 8 session types; per session it writes the session name, simulated duration, and iterates a linked list of weather points chained at node+12, stopping when (*point - duration) * 0.016666668 > 150.0; returns 0 on success and -1 on open failure (with DebugLogWrite logging).

compatibility_contracts.name: D3DApiFailureMarkerContract
compatibility_contracts.description: D3D setup/init routines fail fast with -2005530516 on null arguments or invalid surface types, propagate negative HRESULT-style results from lock/init calls, and use -2147467259 (generic failure) and -2147024882 (failed allocation) for their respective error paths.

unresolved: The exact session-type enum semantics and session state identifiers (NULL exit, state 1 entry) are not grounded in the packet; only the numeric mappings are locked.

D3D vtable method targets are all indirect: surface slots +28/+32/+36 (SurfaceLockBoxCopy), render-resource slots +8/+40/+112, texture scanline slots +4/+8, renderer interface slot +4; none has a static address in the packet.
Offsets +17236/+17240 of the session object and v7+300 of the position-monitor result belong to objects absent from the packet field table; semantics of those writes are unknown.

dword_7C569C == 5, dword_7CB218 as an input count, dbl_5D6D70 dual use (1.0 integration marker vs scaling factor), and the bit indices 20/29/33/34 in byte_7CA594 are unestablished beyond the raw guards.
The weather linked-list +12 next-node layout is inferred from call shape only; this+0x44 and *(this+0x44) appear in the field table but not in the raw decompiled body.
The VTableReleaseClearThunk (0x0050696C) target address is named but not evidenced in the packet; the underlying VTableReleaseClear behavior is unknown.
The final computation helper (ShortComputation_cb70) of ResourceCleanup_cd10 and the purpose of the EmptyStub_7470 call in the free sequence are unverified.

A cluster of fact-table globals does not appear in the decompiled bodies (0x0059E420, 0x0059E440, 0x0059E5FC, 0x0059E6F8, 0x0059E880, 0x0059E9C0, 0x005ACB08, 0x008AC494, 0x008AFE88, 0x008AFE94, 0x008AFE9C, 0x008B8F24, 0x008AFE64, 0x007CDE00); their roles are unknown.
Ownership classes of most functions remain packet-UNKNOWN; all class/interface boundaries here are DERIVED/GUESS and must not be promoted without independent evidence.
Meaning of the 296-byte subslot stride, the two released regions (slot+81/slot+98), the four -1-initialized session slots (stride 0x128), and the 524292 default flag is not established.
